pictures.scene: Leonardo da Vinci, The Virgin of the Rocks — the mother gathering the children in under her hand in the shadow of the great overhanging rock, he who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty
pictures.name: pd_leonardo_schuilplaats

pictures.scene: Karl Friedrich Schinkel, Mittelalterliche Stadt — the walled town standing up on its rock with the towers and the gate above the river, I will say to the LORD, You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust
pictures.name: pd_schinkel_vesting

pictures.scene: Frans Snyders, Concert of Birds — the whole crowd of birds singing together in the branches out of any man's reach, surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler
pictures.name: pd_snyders_strik

pictures.scene: Melchior d'Hondecoeter, Het drijvend veertje — the birds on the quiet water with the one feather floating free on the surface, and from the deadly plague, He will cover you with His feathers
pictures.name: pd_hondecoeter_veren

pictures.scene: Ferdinand Hodler, Der Auserwählte — the great wings opened over the child kneeling in the field, under His wings you will find refuge, His faithfulness is a shield and rampart
pictures.name: pd_hodler_vleugels

pictures.scene: Andrea Mantegna, Saint Sebastian — the bound martyr standing full of arrows and still looking up out of the ruin, you will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day
pictures.name: pd_mantegna_pijl

pictures.scene: Arnold Böcklin, Die Pest — Death riding down the street of the stricken town with the scythe over the fallen, nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon
pictures.name: pd_bocklin_pest

pictures.scene: Jan Matejko, The Battle of Grunwald — the whole field of men and horses going down together in the press of the battle, though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand
pictures.name: pd_matejko_duizend

pictures.scene: Simon de Myle, Noah's Ark on Mount Ararat — the ark come to rest on the mountain with every creature walking down out of it unharmed, no harm will come near you
pictures.name: pd_demyle_kwaad

pictures.scene: Benjamin West, Death on a Pale Horse — the pale rider breaking through with his whole train of ruin behind him while the watchers shrink back, you will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked
pictures.name: pd_west_straf

pictures.scene: Isaac Levitan, Evening Bells — the monastery standing white among its trees across the still water in the evening light, because you have made the LORD your dwelling, my refuge, the Most High
pictures.name: pd_levitan_toevlucht

pictures.scene: Michael Willmann, Landscape with Jacob's Dream — the sleeper lying safe on the ground under the opened sky with the angels going up and down the ladder, no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent
pictures.name: pd_willmann_engelen

pictures.scene: Workshop of Andrea del Verrocchio, Tobias and the Angel — the angel walking the boy along the road with his hand held and the dog running ahead, for He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways
pictures.name: pd_verrocchio_wegen

pictures.scene: Lucas Cranach the Elder, Samson Overcoming the Lion — the young man taking hold of the lion and bearing it down on the stony ground, they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone
pictures.name: pd_cranach_leeuw

pictures.scene: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo, The Immaculate Conception — the woman standing in the light with her foot set down on the head of the serpent, you will tread on the lion and cobra, you will trample the young lion and serpent
pictures.name: pd_tiepolo_slang

pictures.scene: Titian, Noli me tangere — Mary reaching out to the risen Lord in the garden at the moment she knows who He is, because he loves Me, I will deliver him, because he knows My name, I will protect him
pictures.name: pd_titiaan_naam

pictures.scene: Annibale Carracci, Domine, quo vadis — Peter stopped on the road by the Lord coming to meet him and answer him, when he calls out to Me, I will answer him, I will be with him in trouble
pictures.name: pd_carracci_antwoord

pictures.scene: Nicolas Poussin, The Triumph of David — the women coming out singing and the trumpets going up before the young man brought home in honor, I will deliver him and honor him
pictures.name: pd_poussin_eer

pictures.scene: Arkhip Kuindzhi, Red Sunset on the Dnieper — the whole sky burning over the low land with the sun's road laid out in gold across the river, with long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation
pictures.name: pd_kuindzhi_redding

lines.text: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High
will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress,
my God, in whom I trust.”
Surely He will deliver you
from the snare of the fowler,
and from the deadly plague.
He will cover you with His feathers;
under His wings you will find refuge;
His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
You will not fear the terror of the night,
nor the arrow that flies by day,
nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness,
nor the calamity that destroys at noon.
Though a thousand may fall at your side,
and ten thousand at your right hand,
no harm will come near you.
You will only see it with your eyes
and witness the punishment of the wicked.
Because you have made the LORD your dwelling—
my refuge, the Most High—
no evil will befall you,
no plague will approach your tent.
For He will command His angels concerning you
to guard you in all your ways.
They will lift you up in their hands,
so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
You will tread on the lion and cobra;
you will trample the young lion and serpent.
“Because he loves Me, I will deliver him;
because he knows My name, I will protect him.
When he calls out to Me,
I will answer him;
I will be with him in trouble.
I will deliver him and honor him.
With long life I will satisfy him
and show him My salvation.”
